environment.description: Same application deployed on the same EC2 instance type behind an ALB. The ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: A custom rule with a RegexPatternSet match on the query string component, pattern `(?i)(union\s+select|;\s*drop|;\s*insert|;\s*update|;\s*delete|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*and\s+')`, action BLOCK. (2) Priority 200: AWS Managed Rule Group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK), override action COUNT disabled, sensitivity level set to HIGH. (3) Priority 300: AWS Managed Rule Group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule (blocks query strings exceeding 2048 bytes). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating and blocking matching requests. The WAFv2 inspection covers all query string parameters including URL-decoded values.

config.instance: t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, security group allows inbound only from ALB security group
